Attack cards most efficient to gain stats 

- 8 serufs

End of the day it depends on what the system gives you. No need to force yourself to go into whichever combination above 

Same goes for all defense and guard cards

At a certain level, to make the dyle / robo/ dark goo to do better than the character level, you need a grand total of 500 total card level Jesus fucking Christ

What do you do now? Once you have all the stated monster cards? 

We wait. We wait for the entry of T1 cards into the *ANE SHOP* which requires certain combination to work well

T1 cards can slowly be added in ANE dust shop

But hey I have my old serufs.. dyles and Etc. 

Remember, T1 cards gives a fix value of 20% for 3 piece. 

So we should go for the highest gains which is 5 T1 cards + Dyle or seruf for attacks whichever you have more of
Comparison of lvl 155 character level vs lvl 500 total MC level

In short you would only start replacing T2 with T1 WHEN your cards total level hits a minimum of ***500***

Please use the Spreadsheet in #📖│bible , under "MONSTER CARD" Sheet to calculate which is better for you. One might win the other depending on your level so you might have to reset every 5 levels respectively.

The replacement mentioned will mean replacing 3 for 3 or 5 for 5 respectively.

What the fuck is soul of attack defense or guard? 

Here’s an easy way to understand. 

They require you to devour your purple, gold and orange cards to gain a shit load of stats! 

Example, for attack, at a certain level you can gain up to 10% atk for the first 10 seconds! 

We termed it as Extraction. How many do you need for purple cards? 

Each soul takes 12 purple cards of each category. Eg 12 purple attack cards, any of them will do. 

Best to keep 13 or so in case they fuck it up.

***HOW SHOULD I LEVEL MY MONSTER CARDS?***
Orange Cards naturally provides more base bonus (Per 5 levels) than Yellow Cards, so you should always embed Orange Cards whenever possible. 

If the monster cards you possess are low levelled, then it might be better to use Yellow with Set Bonuses instead of changing out to Orange. For instance, if your Orange Monster card will only hit level 10 (at best) then the Yellow Set bonus might have an edge over using that extra Orange card.

The levelling category priority is **Attack > Guard > Defense**. The reason for Guard to be better than Defense is because Guard base stat is Attack % whereas for Defense it's HP Bonus %. 

The best way to upgrade your cards is to level in sets of 5s, so for each card you'll work on hitting the next 5-level checkpoint before moving on to the next.

Each level on your individual monster card will give you 0.1% extra of the base stat bonus that they provide. (Under "Basic Attribute", there's <Base Stat> and <Base Stat Bonus>, I am referring to the bonus here)

You'll have variations of different packs for level 164, this is one of the examples

Orange Card Fragment Selector is random chance to get T3 cards, namely Seruf, Deo or Eliza.

Not hitting the requirement will disallow you from making future extractions.
